$comment: UNICA tech stack, machine-readable. The prose twin is ./tech-stack.md and the two must agree. Every version was read from a real file (foundry.toml, package.json, bun.lock, a submodule SHA) or from --version output on 2026-09-08; none is written from memory. Every entry carries the command that re-derives it.

brand.core: A merchant's till becomes a portfolio — and the portfolio still spends.
brand.supporting: Exact settlement today. Merchant-controlled treasury automation is being built.

independence: Built by NFTeria. Independent — not commissioned by, affiliated with, endorsed by or reviewed by Uniswap or any sponsor.
audit: No part of UNICA has been audited.

statusVocabulary.LIVE_AND_VERIFIED: deployed on a public chain, source verified, and a transaction proves it ran
statusVocabulary.LIVE_BUILD_TIME: part of the live artifact's build, but not itself a deployed thing
statusVocabulary.LIVE_CI: runs on every push against this repository
statusVocabulary.IMPLEMENTED_SIMULATOR_ONLY: the code runs, in a vendor simulator that the vendor states is not the real execution environment; nothing has run in production
statusVocabulary.IMPLEMENTED_LIVE_READ_ONLY: local tests plus read-only reads against a live public chain; nothing is written and nothing is deployed
statusVocabulary.IMPLEMENTED_NOT_DEPLOYED: the code exists and named tests exercise it; nothing is deployed anywhere
statusVocabulary.IMPLEMENTED_FORK_TESTS_NOT_SHIPPED: exercised against a local fork of live chain state; not shipped, and blocked
statusVocabulary.IMPLEMENTED_LOCAL_TESTS: the code exists and named tests exercise it locally; nothing is deployed
statusVocabulary.IMPLEMENTED_PUBLISH_OWNER_GATED: the code exists; making it public is an owner action that has not been confirmed
statusVocabulary.TOOLING_DEPENDENCY: not part of the product; required to re-run the verification

urlProvenanceVocabulary.in-tree: the URL is cited in this repository
urlProvenanceVocabulary.deployment-record: the URL addresses an artifact this repository deployed and can be read back from the chain
urlProvenanceVocabulary.package-registry: constructed from the package name in a lockfile, not read from this tree
urlProvenanceVocabulary.well-known: the project's canonical home; not read from this tree

coreLive.role: The settlement hook and the settlement executor — the whole on-chain guarantee.
coreLive.version: solc 0.8.30, evm_version cancun, via_ir false, bytecode_hash none, cbor_metadata false
coreLive.notes: cancun is required: Uniswap v4 uses transient storage (EIP-1153). bytecode_hash=none and cbor_metadata=false are what make a mined CREATE2 salt reproducible on any machine.

coreLive.role: Build, test, fuzz, script, deploy and verify. There is no other build system in this repository.
coreLive.version: CI pins v1.5.1 via foundry-rs/foundry-toolchain@v1; the machine this manifest was verified on ran forge 1.3.5-foundry-zksync-v0.1.9
coreLive.notes: The two differ. CI's pinned run is the authority; the 182/0 Solidity result recorded here was produced by the local build. Recorded rather than smoothed over.

coreLive.role: PoolManager, Hooks, PoolKey, BalanceDelta, BeforeSwapDelta, and the flash-accounting lock the executor settles inside.
coreLive.evidenceCommand: git -C lib/uniswap-hooks/lib/v4-core rev-parse HEAD && git -C lib/uniswap-hooks/lib/v4-core describe --tags

coreLive.role: IV4Router, Actions, ActionConstants and IMsgSender — the official Universal Router path the hook admits and everything else it refuses.
BaseHook, the base class the live hook inherits, and IHookEvents — the standard HookFee event the receipt emits alongside UNICA's own SettlementReceipt, so a generic indexer sees the settlement too.
coreLive.versionSource: submodule HEAD; the SHA is asserted byte-for-byte in .github/workflows/ci.yml

transitiveDependency.note: Present and remapped, but no file under src/ imports @openzeppelin/contracts directly. Listed as transitive, not as a direct dependency.

coreLive.role: AddressConstants — chain-id to canonical v4 addresses inside the live contracts, which is what lets the hook take a zero-argument constructor and keep one address per chain. Also supplies the official PoolManager runtime bytecode the test base deploys instead of recompiling it.
The only chain UNICA is deployed to. Every script refuses any chain id that is not a listed testnet, by construction.
coreLive.notes: V1 is live and source-verified, with exactly one settlement receipted on chain. There is no mainnet deployment and no path to one in this tree.

coreLive.role: The one payout currency a V1 settlement may deliver, resolved from the chain id and not configurable — so nobody can stand up a pool of their own devising and mint a receipt naming a recipient who received something worthless.
coreLive.notes: Sepolia testnet USDC. A different chain and a different contract from the Arc entry below; the two are never interchangeable.

coreLive.role: Every off-chain tool: the read-only receipt verifier, the client signing tool, the ENS resolution chain, the Arc treasury model, the CRE policy engine, the subgraph consistency checks, the interface-freeze and tool-ledger validators, and the checkout surface.
coreLive.evidenceCommand: grep -rhE "^import .*from ['\"][^.]" --include='*.mjs' tools/ integrations/ script/ web/ --exclude-dir=node_modules | sort -u
coreLive.notes: Zero third-party runtime dependencies. The evidence command returns only node: builtins (node:child_process, node:fs, node:http, node:path, node:process, node:url). There is no package.json at the repository root. 1,543 rows across 14 suites, 0 failed.

coreLive.role: The gate on every push: one shared definition with `make gate`, plus a fresh-clone lane that clones like a stranger, a provenance lane that checks authorship over the whole history, and a shared secret scan.
coreLive.version: jobs: gate, fresh-clone, provenance; the Solidity test count is asserted, not assumed

implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.role: handlerInTee reads five private policy values inside the handler and publishes a commitment, an action class and a reason category — never a threshold.
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.statusText: The workflow RUNS in Chainlink's own simulator: `cre workflow simulate` exits 0, the simulator reports 'Handler requested TEE Execution', secrets load inside the handler, and no threshold reaches any published field. Evidence grade CRE_CONFIDENTIAL_SIMULATION. THE CLI STATES ITS SIMULATOR IS NOT A REAL TEE. Nothing has run in an enclave. Deploy access requested, pending Chainlink's review.
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.version: @chainlink/cre-sdk 1.18.0; viem 2.56.3; typescript 5.9.3; runtime bun with engines.bun >= 1.2.21 declared (this machine: bun 1.2.5)
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.notes: TypeScript appears in this repository only here. The evidence grade TEE_ATTESTED exists in evidence.mjs and is deliberately not what this workflow returns.

implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.technology: ENSv2 (Universal Resolver v2, Permissioned Resolver, Enhanced Access Control)
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.role: Merchant discovery: a payer types a name, the surface resolves it and shows the address before payment; and the harder question — who may change that record — read live from the deployed Permissioned Resolver.
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.statusText: 278 offline rows plus 78 live read-only Sepolia rows. The authorization contrast is observed on the deployed resolver: the same setAddr calldata is ACCEPTED from the account holding ROLE_SET_ADDR and REFUSED from a derived probe. Nothing is ever written. UNICA OWNS NO ENS NAME — every live row reads a name somebody else registered.
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.version: UpgradableUniversalResolverProxy 0xeEeEEEeE14D718C2B47D9923Deab1335E144EeEe on Sepolia; 2,491 bytes of runtime read back 2026-09-05, codehash 0xf7ead24f8e5e731683ed38f7cd5052db9e3e8150fb2b5bc76c1a1bb450af74c5
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.notes: No ENS implementation source is copied; ensdomains/contracts-v2 publishes no licence, so only the documented signatures are used. Per-text-key and per-coin-type resource derivations are marked DOCUMENTED_NOT_OBSERVED and the offline suite fails if anyone promotes them without a measurement.

implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.role: Two subgraphs — V1 settlement receipts and V2 invoice settlements — plus a live Graph client and a deterministic treasury copilot over the indexed rows.
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.statusText: NO SUBGRAPH HAS BEEN DEPLOYED TO SUBGRAPH STUDIO AND NO SUCCESSFUL LIVE READ HAS EVER BEEN OBSERVED. `make graph-v2-live` exits non-zero with UNICA_SUBGRAPH_URL unset, so an absent endpoint can never read as a pass. The Studio deploy is an owner action.
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.version: @graphprotocol/graph-cli 0.98.1; @graphprotocol/graph-ts 0.38.2; matchstick-as 0.6.0; manifest specVersion 1.0.0, mapping apiVersion 0.0.9, language wasm/assemblyscript
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.notes: The address in graph-v2/subgraph.yaml is the FORK-LOCAL executor from test/fork. V2 is not deployed to any public chain.

implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.role: A merchant treasury flow on Arc: read the position, decide one bounded action from a closed vocabulary, render the transaction a wallet would sign — then stop. Plus a nanopayments vector check that verifies a vector Circle's own SDK signed, without importing that SDK.
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.statusText: NOTHING BROADCAST. There is no UNICA contract on Arc and no swap path there. Local tests plus a read-only live check that exits non-zero when it reaches nothing.
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.version: Arc testnet only, chain id 5042002. Native gas asset is USDC carried at 18 decimals; the ERC-20 USDC at 0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000 answers decimals() = 6. The unit system makes the two representations structurally non-interchangeable.
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.versionSource: docs/ARC-FACTS.md (official rows and observed RPC rows, retrieved 2026-09-08)
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.notes: Arc mainnet does not exist. An earlier revision of docs/ARC-FACTS.md overclaimed that USDC is 18 decimals natively on Arc; correcting that is the reason integrations/arc-treasury exists, and the correction is left visible.

implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.role: In V2 ONLY: the payer's witness-bound signature transfer that moves funds from the payer straight to the PoolManager, between sync and settle, so the executor never takes custody.
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.statusText: THE PRESENTED VERSION DOES NOT USE PERMIT2 — the evidence command returns no match against V1's sources. Permit2 appears only under src/v2/, and V2 is frozen as v2.0.0-rc1 and BLOCKED by an open Critical the team found, reproduced and published itself. Not shipped.
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.version: submodule cc56ad0f3439c502c246fc5cfcc3db92bb8b7219 (transitive, under v4-periphery). Canonical deployment address 0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3.
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.notes: The interface is re-declared rather than imported: Permit2's source pins pragma solidity 0.8.17 and this tree pins 0.8.30. The digest is derived twice — once in JavaScript, once in Solidity — because a digest a wallet computes differently from the contract is rejected in the wallet, not in the test suite.

implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.role: The settlement and merchant-split model. merchant_policy.vy is the truth for the split; the JavaScript an Arc console would show a merchant is checked against 26 rows of what the Vyper actually computed, because the place the two can disagree is rounding.
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.statusText: 82 passed, 0 failed. Nothing deployed. vy/moccasin.toml has no live network section at all, so no command in that workspace can be pointed at a chain by accident.
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.notes: Two further .vy files sit in vy/src/unica/ untracked and are not part of the repository.

implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.role: The one page: type a merchant name, see the resolved address, pay in ETH, the recipient is paid in USDC, read the receipt back from the chain.
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.statusText: NOT CONFIRMED PUBLISHED. The Pages deploy job is skipped until the owner enables GitHub Pages and sets the repository variable PAGES_ENABLED=true; the check job runs on every push regardless.
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.version: 651 lines. No framework, no build step, no bundler, no backend, no web font, no external stylesheet.
implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.notes: wouldBeUrl is what docs/PUBLISHING.md says the address will be once the owner enables Pages. It is not confirmed live and must not be presented as such.

implementedLocalOrOwnerGated.role: Not a product technology — a dependency of the verification tooling. Moccasin runs on it and docs/proof/*.sh parse JSON receipts with it.

excluded.verdict: NOT WIRED INTO ANY SHIPPED PATH
excluded.detail: Appears only as ipfs/kubo:v0.34.1 in integrations/graph/local/docker-compose.yml and integrations/graph/local-e2e.sh — a local graph-node harness for reconstructing an index offline. No UNICA artifact is pinned to IPFS and nothing UNICA ships reads from it.
No bucket, no distribution, no SDK, no credential. Every apparent match is either a vendored lockfile under lib/ or the English word 'withdraws'.
Same file as IPFS above. Not required to build, test, deploy or verify UNICA.
The live contracts are Solidity and every shipped off-chain tool is plain .mjs. TypeScript appears only in the Chainlink CRE workflow; the subgraph mappings are AssemblyScript compiled by graph-cli.
Testnet only, by construction: _need-network in the Makefile refuses any --network that is not sepolia, and UniswapDeployments.sol reverts UnsupportedChainId for every chain but 11155111.

solidityForkTests.note: excluded from CI on purpose — they need archive state at a pinned block; run with `make fork`

limitations: The Foundry version differs between CI (pinned v1.5.1) and the machine this manifest was verified on (forge 1.3.5-foundry-zksync-v0.1.9). The 182/0 Solidity result was produced by the local build; CI's own run is the authority on the pinned toolchain.
The 78 live ENSv2 rows were not re-run for this manifest — they require a Sepolia endpoint via `make gate-live`. Only the 278 offline rows were executed.
`make proof`'s 14/14 and 31/31 were not re-run for this manifest — both scripts are pure chain reads and need an endpoint. The row counts in each script were confirmed by reading the scripts.
The Arc live-check rows were not re-run — they need the Arc testnet RPC.
The public URL for the checkout surface is unconfirmed: the Pages deploy job is gated on a repository variable this manifest cannot read.
Package-registry URLs (npmjs.com, pypi.org) and well-known project homes are constructed from the package name or the project name, not read from this tree; urlProvenance records which is which.
`make graph-v2-test` (matchstick mapping tests) was not run — it needs node_modules that a fresh clone does not have. The manifest, ABI and query checks that do not need them were run.
